request.style: English, male baritone voice, gritty and urgent, electric guitar, distorted bass, driving drums, keys, mood is intense and reflective, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You sit in judgment on another
Condemning them for what they do
But you the judge do the same
No excuse remains for you

[Verse]
God's judgment comes according to truth
On those who act in such a way
Do you think you will escape
When you judge others day by day

[Chorus]
Do you despise the riches of his kindness
Forbearance and patience toward you
Not realizing his kindness
Is meant to lead you to repentance

[Verse]
Stubborn heart and unrepentant soul
You store up wrath for yourself
For the day of wrath is coming
When his righteous judgment will be revealed

[Chorus]
Do you despise the riches of his kindness
Forbearance and patience toward you
Not realizing his kindness
Is meant to lead you to repentance

[Bridge]
He will repay each one
According to their works alone
Eternal life for patient endurance
Seeking glory and honor in God

[Chorus]
Do you despise the riches of his kindness
Forbearance and patience toward you
Not realizing his kindness
Is meant to lead you to repentance

[Outro]
His kindness leads you to repentance
Turn away from your stubborn ways
His kindness leads you to repentance
Seek his glory in your days
